text: Water Polo | Georgia’s national team defeated Turkey and took a big step toward the World Cup #1TVSPORT

The Georgian water polo national team played its round-of-16 match in the World Cup qualification stage against Turkey and won 19:12. This was a worthy revenge for the loss to the same team in the group stage.

With this win, the Georgians advanced to the quarterfinals, where their opponent will be determined later (the winner of Canada vs. Ukraine). To qualify for the World Cup, the Georgian national team still needs to win two more matches — the quarterfinal and the semifinal. The two finalists will earn tickets to the World Cup super final.
The 2026 Water Polo World Cup will be held in Australia from July 22 to 26.
